camel_example: aliyun wuyingai Chat --region cn-hangzhou --RoutingKey 'example-string' --Authorization 'Bearer%20eyJhb0000...0000k' --Input '[{"Role":"user","Content":[{"FileUrl":"/workspace/report.pdf","Type":"text","FileName":"report.pdf","ImageUrl":"https://example.com/img.jpg","Text":"帮我分析这张图片"}]}]' --StreamOptions '{"IncludeReasoning":false,"IncludeToolCalls":false}' --Model 'example-string' --ExternalUserId 'test-user' --SessionId 'test-session-001' --TemplateId 'template-abc123' --Settings '{"OutputFileMode":"url"}' --Resume true --version 2026-03-11 --method POST --force
description_en: Initiates a streaming conversation with JVS Crew and uses the Server-Sent Events (SSE) protocol to push conversation content in real time
description_zh: 与 JVS Crew 进行流式对话，采用 Server-Sent Events (SSE) 协议实时推送对话内容
kebab_example: aliyun wuyingai chat --input '[{"Role":"user","Content":[{"FileUrl":"/workspace/report.pdf","Type":"text","FileName":"report.pdf","ImageUrl":"https://example.com/img.jpg","Text":"帮我分析这张图片"}]}]' --session-id test-session-001 --routing-key example-string --authorization Bearer%20eyJhb0000...0000k --external-user-id test-user --template-id template-abc123 --stream-options IncludeReasoning=false IncludeToolCalls=false --settings OutputFileMode=url --model example-string --resume true --region cn-hangzhou
name: Chat

fields.help_en: The name of the file. This parameter is optional when Type is set to file and is used to specify the display name of the file
fields.help_zh: 文件名称。Type=file 时可选，用于指定文件的显示名称
fields.name: file_name

fields.help_en: The file path or URL. This parameter is valid when Type is set to file
fields.name: file_url

fields.help_en: The image URL or Base64-encoded string. This parameter is valid when Type is set to image
fields.name: image_url

fields.help_en: The text content. This parameter is valid when Type is set to text
fields.name: text

fields.help_en: The role of the message sender
fields.name: role

parameters.help_en: The list of messages in JSON string format, arranged in chronological order
parameters.help_zh: 消息列表（JSON 字符串），按时间顺序排列
parameters.name: input

parameters.help_en: The session ID used to maintain context for multi-turn conversations
parameters.help_zh: 会话 ID，用于多轮对话上下文保持
parameters.name: session_id

parameters.help_en: The routing key used to specify the backend instance that processes the request
parameters.help_zh: 路由键，用于指定处理请求的后端实例
parameters.name: routing_key

parameters.help_en: The authorization token in the format of Bearer plus the JSON Web Token (JWT) returned by GetAccessToken. The entire string must be URL-encoded and placed in the query parameters
parameters.help_zh: Bearer + 由 GetAccessToken 返回的 JWT，整段 URL 编码后放入 Query
parameters.name: authorization

parameters.help_en: The user ID in the external system
parameters.name: external_user_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the agent template
parameters.name: template_id

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to include the model reasoning process. If this parameter is set to false, the SSE stream will not include messages with Type="reasoning" and their content events
fields.help_zh: 是否包含模型思考过程。设为 false 时，SSE 流中将不包含 Type="reasoning" 的 message 和其 content 事件
fields.name: include_reasoning

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to include tool invocation details. If this parameter is set to false, the SSE stream will not include messages of the plugin_call, plugin_call_output, mcp_call, or mcp_call_output types and their content events
fields.help_zh: 是否包含工具调用详情。设为 false 时，SSE 流中将不包含 plugin_call/plugin_call_output/mcp_call/mcp_call_output 类型的 message 和其 content 事件
fields.name: include_tool_calls

parameters.help_en: The streaming output control options. This parameter includes IncludeReasoning (Boolean, default value: true, specifies whether to include the model reasoning procedure) and IncludeToolCalls (Boolean, default value: true, specifies whether to include detailed tool invocation information). If this parameter is not passed or a null object is passed, the behavior is consistent with the legacy version
parameters.help_zh: 流式输出控制选项。包含 IncludeReasoning（boolean，默认 true，是否包含模型思考过程）和 IncludeToolCalls（boolean，默认 true，是否包含工具调用详细信息）。不传或传空对象时行为与旧版一致
parameters.name: stream_options

fields.help_en: The parameter that controls the output file mode. Valid values: url and base64. Default value: base64. The default value is used for backward compatibility with the legacy version when this parameter is not passed
fields.help_zh: 控制文件输出模式的参数，可选url或base64， 当前为兼容旧版不传本参数默认使用 base64
fields.name: output_file_mode

parameters.help_en: The additional settings. This parameter includes the OutputFileMode parameter (String, valid values: url or base64, default value: base64 for backward compatibility with the legacy version. The url value is recommended) to control the output file mode
parameters.help_zh: 其他设置信息。包含输出文件模式控制参数OutputFileMode（string，可选url或base64，当前为兼容旧版默认 base64，推荐使用url）
parameters.name: settings

parameters.help_en: The resumable streaming flag. If this parameter is set to true, the previous incomplete streaming response is resumed. In this case, the Input parameter must be empty
parameters.help_zh: 断线续传标识。设为 true 时表示恢复上一次未完成的流式响应，此时 Input 必须为空
parameters.name: resume

SequenceNumber.description_en: The event sequence number, which is an incrementing integer in string format used to ensure order. Note: When StreamOptions filters out certain types of events, the filtered events still occupy sequence numbers. Therefore, the sequence numbers received by the client may not be consecutive
SequenceNumber.description_zh: 事件序号（字符串形式的递增整数，用于保证顺序）。注意：当 StreamOptions 过滤掉某类事件时，被过滤事件仍占用序号，因此客户端收到的序号可能不连续
